verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a physical GPU accelerator with an on-premises or cloud-hosted software stack (ROCm). It does not hold a user's data in a vendor-controlled account, so 'export all my data in open formats and leave' is a SaaS data-portability axis that does not apply to this kind of product. The Prometheus-format Device Metrics Exporter only exports GPU telemetry. It is not a user-data export or exit capability, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
